content: Always consult your healthcare professional for guidance regarding this product and your specific health needs. It is essential to seek complete information from your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use of this product. If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. The information provided here was last revised in July 2024.
